flyer.justification: The flyer captures key themes well and uses proper placeholders, but the title exceeds the required maximum of 6 words.

linkedin.justification: Adheres strictly to all formatting guidelines, avoids banned clichés/buzzwords, and effectively conveys the talk's main insights.

instagram.justification: Follows all Instagram formatting constraints and hashtag counts, with the minor addition of the speaker's name not explicitly given in the transcript or author profile.

summary.justification: Provides a clean, well-structured executive summary under 400 words adhering to all formatting requirements.

newsletter.justification: Adheres to all newsletter requirements, including three bold subheadings, subject line length constraint, and an editorial tone.

blog.justification: An excellent long-form blog post that fully satisfies all structural requirements including numbered sections, comparison table, and author bio.
